_comment: Legistar Web API clients read by live intake (source legistar_renewable_matters in config/sources.yaml;
scripts/fetch.py makes one request per active client, and scripts/extractors/legistar_renewable_matters.py
places each matter in the client's jurisdiction). Hand-edited. A client is listed only once its name is
verified: GET https://webapi.legistar.com/v1/<client>/bodies answers a JSON list, and a body name matches
the jurisdiction ("<Name> County" for a county), since slugs collide across states. An unknown client
answers HTTP 500 ('LegistarConnectionString setting is not set up'). Clients were taken from
there 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-12) where the county holds renewable records here, and re-checked on
verified_on. Finding nothing in a client's matters proves nothing about the county.
2026-10-13: every client below answered /bodies with a JSON list; each note names the bodies that tie it
to its government. Where no body name carries the place name, the client's matter titles were read too.
Discovery the same day: 120 guessed slugs ({name}county{st}, {name}co{st}, {name}{st}, and {name}county
when the name is unique nationally) for the counties with the most renewable records in IA IL NE IN MN VA
NC OH KS GA CO WI MI CA TX WY ND SD, leaving out names data-center-map had probed: all answered HTTP 500,
